description:
Role: Platform Engineer 
 Location: Atlanta, GA (On site 5 days) 
 Type of Hire: Full time/W2  
 Job Description: 
 Responsibilities: 
 Execute on enterprise software supply chain initiatives, supporting secure software delivery. 
 Enhance Sonatype Repository artifact management, IQ firewall policy governance, open-source software lifecycle, and telemetry reporting. 
 Implement software approval workflows, quarantine waiver, and lifecycle management processes. 
 Coordinate dependency upgrades and vulnerability remediation workflows. 
 Support onboarding of emerging ecosystems, including AI/ML frameworks. 
 Develop reporting and metrics for software supply chain health, policy compliance, and repository utilization. 
 Develop CI/CD artifact signing and verification capabilities for software builds. 
 Implement SLSA build provenance and attestations across CI/CD platforms. 
 Integrate SBOM generation and software metadata into build and deployment pipelines. 
  
 Required Technical Skills: 
 3+ years of Platform Engineering, Software Supply Chain Engineering, or Open Source Governance experience. 
 Hands-on experience with Sonatype Lifecycle (IQ Server) and Nexus Repository required. 
 Experience creating and maintaining automated Open Source Software policies, workflows, and telemetry/reporting for component usage, licensing, and vulnerability tracking. 
 Experience implementing artifact signing technologies (Sigstore/Cosign, GPG, Notary, etc.). 
 Experience with SLSA provenance, in-toto attestations, or similar frameworks. 
 Experience with SBOM generation (CycloneDX, SPDX, Syft). 
 CI/CD experience with GitLab preferred (or comparable tooling, e.g. GitHub Actions). 
 Strong AWS experience (IAM, ECS/EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, Step Function, CloudWatch). 
 Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or Go). 
 Familiarity with OCI registries and package ecosystems (Maven, npm, PyPI, NuGet).
